tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background (about 70% of a page). New Legacy token; warm archival ground.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Cards, caption blocks, alternate bands (about 10%).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders only. Decorative; never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings. 14.63:1 on paper, 12.71:1 on sand (light); 15.2:1 and 13.43:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, bylines, captions. Light = kapa-700: 6.63:1 on paper, 5.77:1 on sand. Dark: 9.19:1 / 8.12:1.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Section headings, timeline dates, secondary button labels and outlines. 7.11:1 on paper (light), 10.64:1 (dark).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and tertiary actions on paper and sand. Light = reef-700: 6.29:1 on paper, 5.47:1 on sand. Never reef-600 on paper (4.14:1, fails).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px paper gap, then 2px solid focus.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Header, footer and dark bands. Text on it is on-band or accent-on-band.

tokens.name: band-deep
tokens.usage: Footer, photo scrims at 60% opacity or more.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text on band (7.11:1 light, 9.69:1 dark) and band-deep (11.11:1 light).

tokens.name: accent-on-band
tokens.usage: Torch-200 accents on band: dates, honors, footer headings. 6.37:1 on band (light), 9.3:1 (dark). Never on paper.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: Fill of the ONE primary button per view (Share a Memory). Fill only: as text on paper it is 4.12:1 and fails.

tokens.name: on-cta
tokens.usage: Primary button label. 4.52:1 on cta; keep 16px bold or larger.

tokens.name: lagoon-600
tokens.usage: PCC scale anchor. Structure and dark bands; prefer the semantic tokens heading and band in UI.

tokens.name: lagoon-800
tokens.usage: PCC scale step. Deepest bands and scrims.

tokens.name: reef-600
tokens.usage: PCC link color for white grounds (4.54:1 on white). Fails on paper; not used on Legacy pages.

tokens.name: reef-700
tokens.usage: PCC scale step. Legacy link color on paper and sand.

tokens.name: sunset-500
tokens.usage: PCC signature orange. Identity only (cover, print). White on it is 2.98:1: never a text ground.

tokens.name: sunset-cta
tokens.usage: Design system CTA option A. Same as cta.

tokens.name: torch-200
tokens.usage: PCC scale anchor. Accents on dark grounds only.

tokens.name: kapa-700
tokens.usage: PCC scale anchor. Grounds, borders, secondary text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero lines. 40px on mobile. Never more than 12 words.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-sections and card titles. 21px on mobile.

styles.name: body-story
styles.sample: I came to Lāʻie in 1963 to work my way through school.
styles.usage: Story and history text; 60–75 character measure. 18px on mobile.

styles.name: body-ui
styles.sample: Filter by decade, village or role.
styles.usage: UI text, forms, lists. 16px on mobile.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Canoe pageant, Lāʻie, 1972. Photo: PCC Archives
styles.usage: Metadata and captions in ink-muted. 15px on mobile.

styles.name: timeline-date
styles.usage: Timeline dates in heading color. 22px on mobile.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: We were family before we were performers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: section-sm
tokens.usage: Section rhythm, tight.

tokens.name: section-md
tokens.usage: Section rhythm, default.

tokens.name: section-lg
tokens.usage: Section rhythm, between major bands.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max story text column.

tokens.name: radius-click
tokens.usage: Anything clickable: buttons, chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-contain
tokens.usage: Anything containing: cards, caption blocks, panels.

tokens.name: radius-portrait
tokens.usage: Portraits on person cards only.
